claim: The claim that Jeffrey Epstein flew on Central Intelligence Agency aircraft rests on an April 14, 2017 email thread that shows something narrower and better documented. Larry Visoski, Epstein's chief pilot, spent that day researching a Boeing Business Jet — a BBJ, the corporate conversion of the 737 — that Epstein was considering buying. At 7:37 a.m. he asked the broker: "Are you familiar with the original owner of N720MM? When it was know as N313P?" and linked the Wikipedia entry for Premier Executive Transport Services, one of the shell companies the CIA used to hold aircraft. By 1:08 p.m. he had written to Epstein directly: "Past history of owners of Josh's BBJ was the CIA in 2007, I think A previous N Number indicates N313P was used as a CIA plane to transport prisoners to Guantanamo Bay. It was called a Torture Plane." N313P is a documented tail number in the agency's extraordinary-rendition program, tracked by European investigators looking into flights that carried prisoners to secret detention. Visoski treated the history as a discount and a liability — "It's worth less the $18M with a serial number trace, not sure how the Middle East airports would feel about this serial number upon arrival?" — and Epstein turned the aircraft down the same day: "josh, sorry , we will pass for the moment . cannot justify a price that begins with a 2." The thread runs across Bates EFTA01049323 in Data Set 9 and EFTA02352217 in Data Set 11 of the Justice Department release. What it documents is that Epstein's pilot identified a former CIA rendition aircraft on the resale market and that Epstein declined to buy it.

notes: Backstage. The document is real and is genuinely about a CIA rendition airframe, which is why the claim travels; the part that does not survive is the boarding. Data Set 11 was pulled from justice.gov specifically to close this and it changed the record for the better: EFTA02352217 is not a duplicate of the Data Set 9 copy but a later message the same day, in which Visoski drops the Wikipedia-link indirection and states the CIA, Guantanamo and "Torture Plane" himself. The verbatim is reproduced with its quoted-printable damage (=nk, w=s, cal=ed) intact rather than silently repaired, since that damage is how the produced text is authenticated. The thread is still a purchase negotiation for a used BBJ, the CIA link is raised by Epstein's own pilot as a reason the plane is worth less, and Epstein passes on it the same morning. Group A on the documented facts; the boarding claim is Group C.
